title: Natural partnership: an adjective before “evidence”
instructions: Choose the option that expresses the intended meaning, forms a natural word partnership and fits the situation.

parts.prompt: The dated photographs provide ___ evidence that the bridge was already damaged before the storm.

choice_rationales.A: Tall describes physical height and does not combine with evidence to mean convincing support.
choice_rationales.B: Noisy describes sound or distracting activity, not the reliability of evidence.
choice_rationales.C: Fierce describes intense aggression, competition or conditions and is unnatural with evidence here.
choice_rationales.D: Strong evidence naturally means convincing support, which the dated photographs provide.

parts.hint: Which adjective naturally describes evidence that gives convincing support?
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Strong evidence’ is the natural partnership for convincing support; the dated photographs justify that description.
